author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Open positions: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Looking for people who are serious, consistent, and can work with a team. Send CV & Portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portfolio). Open until all positions are filled.
